cases.assertion: session and safe post and parent IDs are required; invalid and empty content is rejected
hidden, deleted or missing post cannot be commented on before or during insertion
parent belongs to the same post and meets visibility, active-author and bidirectional block rules in both the lookup and insertion
root and reply IDs, content, author, timestamps and viewer state match the common response
post author and distinct parent author receive correctly deduplicated notifications according to preferences
a failure after committed insertion may leave a comment or partial notifications and does not leak internals
both clients send the selected parent for regular and cited comments, retain rejected drafts and clear confirmed drafts; isolated Oracle and Redis remain an acceptance gate
